note: P3a: pure append to live region
P3c: remove + insert in ONE tick (the discriminating case)
P4f: select all in the input (selection change)
P4g: reset caret to offset 0, then ONE ArrowRight, isolated by a boundary
P4k: reset to 0, then FIVE ArrowRights back-to-back (coalescing test)
P4m: focus the contenteditable "Rich editor" (text: "ab [link] cd")
P4n1: ArrowRight #1 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P4n2: ArrowRight #2 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P4n3: ArrowRight #3 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P4n4: ArrowRight #4 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P4n5: ArrowRight #5 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P4n6: ArrowRight #6 in the rich editor (walking towards/through the link)
P5b: ariaNotify on document.body, default priority
P5c: ariaNotify on document.body, priority high
P5d: focus a button first, then ariaNotify on that button
P5e: ariaNotify on the focused button
P5g: extra boundary, to catch any lagged announcement
P5h: role=alert element inserted after boot
P5i: drain boundary after the alert
P5j: text change INSIDE an existing role=alert (the correct pattern)
